settings.title: Never run out of food again
settings.text: Put the foods your animals eat every month on a schedule. You save 10% on every delivery, get free shipping on orders over $100, and you can skip, pause or cancel any time.

settings.title: Save 10% every time
settings.text: Every subscription delivery is 10% off the regular price, for as long as you stay subscribed.

settings.title: Free shipping over $100
settings.text: Subscription orders over $100 ship free, well under the usual $150 free shipping mark.

settings.title: Delivered monthly
settings.text: Your order arrives once a month, so you're topped up before the tub runs out.

settings.title: No lock-in
settings.text: Skip a delivery, change the frequency, pause or cancel any time from your account.

settings.title: Choose your products
settings.text: Pick Subscribe and Save on any product page that offers it, or add it from your cart.

settings.title: Check out once
settings.text: Pay for your first delivery as usual. After that it repeats every month, and we email you before each order ships.

settings.title: We deliver on schedule
settings.text: Fresh stock arrives when you need it. Manage everything from My account.

settings.title: Three steps to set and forget
One tub every month
settings.text: Based on a 500g Freeze-Dried Omnivore Buffet™ delivered every month for a year.
settings.label_total: You save in the first year

settings.title: Can I subscribe to live insects?
settings.text: Yes. Add live insects to your subscription and they arrive with your monthly delivery. Skip a month, pause or cancel any time from My account.

settings.title: When am I charged?
settings.text: Your card is charged when each delivery is prepared. We email you before each order so you can skip or change it.

settings.title: Can I change what is in my subscription?
settings.text: Yes. Swap flavours or sizes, add products, or remove them from My account at any time.

settings.title: Where do you deliver?
settings.text: We currently deliver to QLD, NSW, ACT and VIC, with more areas coming soon.
